beliefs: f is piecewise linear with several segments of different slopes [E1, E2]
For x < -2, slope is about -0.57 per unit x, anchored near f(-2)≈-2.56 [E1]
There is a steep segment near x=0 (roughly -2 to 5) with slope about -3.3, f(0)≈-8.83 [E1]
For x > 5, slope is about -3.05, not -0.57; the kink at x=5 is real and the region above 5 is steeper than the far-left region [E2]
The x>5 region may itself bend slightly (slope near 5.5 is ~-3.05, near 30 is ~-1.0)? [E2]
